# Refine

> Crafting / refining recipes, checked on the server.

- Package: `Refine` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md), [Item](Item.md), [Level](Level.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Refine")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Refine`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/RefineService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Refine = GaxiaServer.Refine
```

### Functions

- `Refine.DefineRecipe(id: string, recipe: Recipe): ()`
- `Refine.DefineMany(defs: { [string]: Recipe }): ()`
- `Refine.GetRecipe(id: string): Recipe?`
- `Refine.ListRecipes(): { string }`
- `Refine.CanCraft(player: Player, recipeId: string): (boolean, string)`
- `Refine.Craft(player: Player, recipeId: string): (boolean, string)`
- `Refine.Begin(player: Player, recipeId: string): (string?, string?)`
  Consume inputs now, queue a timed job. Returns jobId (or nil + error).
- `Refine.GetJobs(player: Player): { [string]: Job }`
- `Refine.GetTimeRemaining(player: Player, jobId: string): number`

- `Refine.Claim(player: Player, jobId: string): (boolean, string)`
  Grant a finished job's outputs and remove it.

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Refine.OnCraft` — `Signal<Player, string, { [string]: number }>`
  (player, recipeId, outputs) after an instant Craft granted its outputs
- `Refine.OnBegin` — `Signal<Player, string, string, number>`
  (player, jobId, recipeId, completeAt) after Begin consumed the inputs and queued a job (completeAt: os.time() seconds)
- `Refine.OnComplete` — `Signal<Player, string, string, { [string]: number }>`
  (player, jobId, recipeId, outputs) after Claim granted a finished job ({} when the recipe no longer exists)

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type Recipe = {
    Inputs: { [string]: number },
    Outputs: { [string]: number },
    Duration: number?,      -- seconds; >0 means it must go through Begin/Claim
    RequiresLevel: number?, -- optional level gate (checked via Gaxia.Level)
}
export type Job = { recipeId: string, completeAt: number }
```
